author_checked_context.meaning: Context of selected main only. These finite reference results do not prove this exponent saving or the multiplication theorem.

summary: Four exact independently accepted sources; 30 standard-only axiom probes and six complete printed types. No publication replay.

modules.printed_full_types:
CurrentMain.Current1094Rows12DyadicReference.rows12_uniform_cell_budget : ∀ (n target source : ℕ),
  source ≠ target →
    ∀ (s : CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.EncodedState)
      (slot : CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.Slot (Fin n)) (b P : ℕ),
      (s.memory (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n target slot)).numerator.natAbs < 2 ^ b →
        (s.memory (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n source slot)).numerator.natAbs < 2 ^ b →
          (s.memory (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n target slot)).fractionalBits ≤ P →
            (s.memory (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n source slot)).fractionalBits ≤ P →
              ((CurrentMain.Current1094Row2DyadicReference.runAdd
                          (CurrentMain.Current1094Rows12DyadicReference.rows12Program n target source) s).memory
                      (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n target slot)).fractionalBits ≤
                  P + 1 ∧
                ((CurrentMain.Current1094Row2DyadicReference.runAdd
                            (CurrentMain.Current1094Rows12DyadicReference.rows12Program n target source) s).memory
                        (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n target slot)).numerator.natAbs <
                  2 ^ (b + P + 1)
modules.scope: Composes the existing SCALE and ADD reference tapes in actual order (16*n instructions), with every-prefix full-state real decoding, source/outside-cell preservation, and exact raw target addCell(minusHalfCell t,halfCell u). The two original numerator/exponent bounds yield exponent <= P+1 and magnitude < 2^(b+P+1).

modules.scope: Bounds every instruction prefix on the two finite active blocks and the initially dirty accumulator: StateBudget(b,P) gives StateBudget(b+P+1,P+1), independent of n and prefix k. Unrelated memory is unrestricted.

modules.printed_full_types:
CurrentMain.FixedGridReference.step_encode : ∀ (Q : ℕ) (op : CurrentMain.FixedGridReference.Instruction)
  (s : CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.EncodedState),
  (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2DyadicReference.stepAdd op s).accumulator.fractionalBits ≤ Q →
    CurrentMain.FixedGridReference.step op (CurrentMain.FixedGridReference.encode Q s) =
      CurrentMain.FixedGridReference.encode Q (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2DyadicReference.stepAdd op s)
CurrentMain.FixedGridReference.selected_prefix_values : ∀ (n b P : ℕ)
  (s : CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.EncodedState),
  CurrentMain.Current1094Rows12PrefixBitBudget.StateBudget
      (CurrentMain.Current1094Rows12PrefixBitBudget.footprint n
        CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.selectedTargetFamily
        CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.selectedSourceFamily)
      b P s →
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      (∀
          a ∈
            CurrentMain.Current1094Rows12PrefixBitBudget.footprint n
              CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.selectedTargetFamily
              CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.selectedSourceFamily,
          ↑((CurrentMain.FixedGridReference.run
                      (List.take k (CurrentMain.Current1094Rows12DyadicReference.selectedRows12Program n))
                      (CurrentMain.FixedGridReference.encode (P + 1) s)).memory
                  a) /
              2 ^ (P + 1) =
            CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
              ((CurrentMain.Current1094Row2DyadicReference.runAdd
                    (List.take k (CurrentMain.Current1094Rows12DyadicReference.selectedRows12Program n)) s).memory
                a)) ∧
        ↑(CurrentMain.FixedGridReference.run
                  (List.take k (CurrentMain.Current1094Rows12DyadicReference.selectedRows12Program n))
                  (CurrentMain.FixedGridReference.encode (P + 1) s)).accumulator /
            2 ^ (P + 1) =
          CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
            (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2DyadicReference.runAdd
                (List.take k (CurrentMain.Current1094Rows12DyadicReference.selectedRows12Program n)) s).accumulator
modules.scope: Defines a fixed-denominator integer interpreter and proves its per-step and prefix simulation under post-step exponent bounds. HALVE parity is derived, not assumed. At selected rows1-2, Q=P+1 follows from the previous finite-footprint budget; decoding includes visible accumulator.

CurrentMain.SelectedFirstButterflyReference.selected_endpoint_values : ∀ (n : ℕ)
  (s : CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.EncodedState)
  (slot : CurrentMain.ComponentStoreFoldRefinement.Slot (Fin n)),
  CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
        ((CurrentMain.Current1094Row2DyadicReference.runAdd
              (CurrentMain.SelectedFirstButterflyReference.selectedProgram n) s).memory
          (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n 119 slot)) =
      (CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
            (s.memory (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n 169 slot)) -
          CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
            (s.memory (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n 119 slot))) /
        2 ∧
    CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
        ((CurrentMain.Current1094Row2DyadicReference.runAdd
              (CurrentMain.SelectedFirstButterflyReference.selectedProgram n) s).memory
          (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n 169 slot)) =
      (CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
            (s.memory (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n 169 slot)) +
          CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
            (s.memory (CurrentMain.Current1094Row2AddReference.address n 119 slot))) /
        2
modules.scope: Adds the actual third raw ADD row to the first two, counts 24*n reference instructions, derives both raw Cell endpoints ((u-t)/2,(u+t)/2), preserves outside memory, and proves Q=P+1 refinement for every prefix. The signed H0 orientation is explicit; this is the original three-row subroutine, not the complete selected transform.

limits: All arithmetic is unbounded Int/Nat/Real reference semantics. The 16*n and 24*n lengths count reference instructions, not primitive bit operations.
Initial finite-footprint and visible-accumulator magnitude/exponent bounds remain hypotheses. Unrelated memory is unrestricted; real decoding is asserted only where the exponent bound holds.

Fixed-Q initial scaling is a mathematical representation equation, not paid physical initialization or a global precision selection. Integer halving is exact because parity follows from the stated exponent bound.
The exact first-three-row endpoint has a signed H0 output orientation. Full selected-layer layout/order, recursive child endpoints and final computed-round arrays remain separate.
No physical finite-word controller, Program/Host simulation, stack cleanup, output packing, global recurrence coefficient or full multiplication theorem is supplied by this package.
publication_evidence: Original failures, exact proof-only repair histories and independent source/terminal receipts are retained by the authors. This summary binds public source hashes, theorem probes and complete types; it exports no private runtime paths or telemetry.
